title: AgenticTactileVLA: Contact-Guided Execution-Time Supervision for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation without VLA Retraining

tldr.zh:
**反馈与纠错：**在 VLA 闭合手指后，用指令与实际指位的偏差、以及纠正时的电机负载反馈判断接触；抓握不足时暂停后续身体运动指令的推进（保持身体稳定），逐指补闭合至接触，满足支持判据则保持手形继续执行，否则交回 VLA 重试。
**作用位置：**外部、无需训练的监督层修改执行指令；修正后的手部状态进入下一轮 VLA 观测，不更新 VLA 参数。基础 VLA 已用遥操作示范微调。
**柔顺模式：**闭合前由语言提示或 VLM 选择预设限流控制，减小对易损物体的挤压；无需额外触觉传感器，电机反馈不等于标定接触力。
tldr.en:
**Feedback/correction:** After nominal VLA finger closure, detect contact evidence from commanded-versus-measured finger motion and, during correction, motor-effort feedback. If support is insufficient, pause body-reference progression while maintaining stabilization and advance unsupported fingers independently until contact. Retain the corrected hand configuration when support criteria pass; otherwise return control to the VLA for retry.
**Where it acts:** An external, nonlearned supervisor changes executed commands; the corrected hand state enters subsequent VLA observations without updating VLA parameters. The base VLA was fine-tuned on teleoperated demonstrations.
**Compliant mode:** Before closure, language cues or a VLM select predefined current-limited control for fragile objects. No additional tactile sensors are required; motor feedback is not calibrated contact force.

evaluation_scope.zh: Unitree G1＋BrainCo Revo2，固定 GR00T-N1.6-3B；5 个训练外物体、每物体 15 次配对试验，共享 60 秒／最多 3 次接近预算，完成率由基础 VLA 的 61.3% 提升到 84.0%（无条件补闭合为 72.0%）。柔顺分支仅验证闭合与保持时的物体完整性，未验证自主搬运；未证明跨手型或跨 VLA 通用。
evaluation_scope.en: Unitree G1 with BrainCo Revo2 and fixed GR00T-N1.6-3B; five held-out objects, 15 matched trials per object, with a shared 60-second/three-approach budget. Completion rises from 61.3% for the base VLA to 84.0% (72.0% for unconditional close-to-stall). The compliant branch evaluates object integrity during closure and holding, not autonomous transport; cross-hand and cross-VLA generality are not established.
